rationale: aria-label from the placeholder, name or id
before:
<input
      type="text"
      id="pass192"
      aria-invalid="true"
      aria-errormessage="pass192-ref1"
      aria-describedby="pass192-ref1 pass192-ref2"
    />
after:
<input
      type="text"
      id="pass192"
      aria-invalid="true"
      aria-errormessage="pass192-ref1"
      aria-describedby="pass192-ref1 pass192-ref2" aria-label="pass192"/>
